verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents a built-in AI agent, Phoenix Intelligence, that users can hand investigations to. It inspects traces, iterates prompts and runs experiments, which directly matches delegating tasks to an in-product assistant. The evidence is a single line in the llms.txt index, so the depth of the capability is unverified. The remote MCP endpoint and coding-agent setup CLI let external agents act on Phoenix, so they were not credited here. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party docs on Phoenix Intelligence's scope, controls and supported task types, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
